interface.description: The default network interface to bind to for IPv6 packet transmission.

source_ip.description: The source IPv6 address to use in crafted packets. Leave empty for auto.

target_ip.description: The target IPv6 address for attacks. Leave empty to prompt per-tool.

verbose.description: Enable verbose logging/output for the toolkit tools.

domain_name.description: Domain name parameter for tools like flood_dhcpc6.

dictionary_file.description: Path to a custom wordlist for dnsdict6 enumeration.
